name: Supercell at Dusk
promptTemplate: A supercell thunderstorm on the plains at dusk with {{storm_palette}} skies, {{rotation_speed}}x mesocyclone rotation, {{lightning_rate}} lightning activity, {{curtain_drift}} wind-sheared rain curtains, {{anvil_size}} anvil expanse, and prairie silhouettes {{prairie_silhouettes}}.

rotation_speed.hint: Spins the stacked barber-pole wall cloud tiers

curtain_drift.hint: Tilts precipitation curtains under strong low-level shear

anvil_size.hint: Expands the high sheared cloud deck across the sky

prairie_silhouettes.hint: Toggles horizon grain elevators, windmills, and trees

listing.blurb: A banded supercell rotates over dusk plains while sheet flashes and lightning forks illuminate drifting rain curtains.
listing.prompt: A supercell thunderstorm on the plains at dusk: a rotating wall cloud with banded layers turns slowly over flat land, lit from within by flashes, rain curtains hanging beneath. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
